reviews.text:
Although it is a very old neighborhood bakery, it still maintains its position among the numerous bakeries in Yeonhui-dong.
There are many different types and there is a branch inside Sarega Mart.
(The menus of the two places feel slightly different. The main store has more traditional breads, but Saroga Mart seems to be a little more in line with trends.)

As you can see from the business name, it's an old place, but my mother said she ate their bread when she was pregnant with me...

Anyway, there is a reason why it lasts so long. The overall quality is not bad and the types are diverse.

Due to the nature of the bakery, there is nothing particularly friendly about it, but the employees are still friendly.

There are many modern-style restaurants in Yeonhui-dong, but I feel fortunate that these old houses take center stage.
I hope the store lasts 100 years.

reviews.text:
A gelato cafe where you can enjoy the aesthetics of taste for 5,000-6,000 won.
The menu, which is challenging just to look at, offers a variety of flavors by boldly using spices that are not often used in Korea, such as shiso and cardamom, and Korean ingredients such as Schisandra chinensis and black sesame seeds.
Taking the black sesame citron cream as an example, the taste of fresh yuzu is slightly enhanced by fragrant black sesame seeds, and it ends with the taste of heavy and thick cream. Gelato has a clear barrier to taste and the three different flavors can be felt at different times. As a resident of Yeonhui-dong, I am delighted to hear that all ingredients, origins, and varieties are disclosed and that it is run by an Italian owner.

A regular place for at least 6 years.

Banquet noodles 3,000 won per serving

The portions are generous, the broth is delicious, and the noodles are chewy.
It has fried tofu and fish cakes in it, as well as spicy red pepper powder!

Even though it is not fried, the skin is crispy and chewy.
The meat is soft~

Because it tastes best when scraped when it becomes crispy~ haha
There are many different dipping sauces, but my favorite is

If you fall in love with the mustard sauce here, you won't eat anything else.

They even take coupons!! If you collect 10, you get 1 free.
It's hard to get this quality at this price these days...ㅠㅠ
Please stay in business for a long time!! ㅠㅠ
This is a restaurant that my family and friends all love. ㅠㅠ

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
After eating my fill at Ipoom, my family asked me to buy a cup of coffee on the way home, so I remembered the last time I stopped by the nearby Yeonhee Ilpoomhyang and decided to stop by here, the Yeonhee DT store across the street.

There was a long line of cars on the side of the road to use the drive-thru, so I decided to just go into the store and order. I got out of the car and entered the store, and it was nice and cool, but when I went up to see what the atmosphere was like on the second floor, the large store was full of customers.

I went back down to the first floor and ordered Kenya, an iced coffee from the common coffee of the day menu, in a venti size.

It may be because it was a drive-thru store, but even though there were a lot of employees, it took quite a while for the Ice Kenya I ordered to come out. When I finally got my order number called and went to get it, I was probably surprised the last time, but the size of the Venti was as small as the Grande. It felt like it was a true story, and I was shaking my head as to why it was so small.

I thought to myself that it should be almost twice the size of the Venti.

I took it out and tasted it in the car, and of course it wasn't a reserve drink or an espresso drink, but when I compared it to the high-end coffee soda I drank at Epe Coffee earlier, it tasted like a plain franchise-like coffee with no soul at all, so I couldn't help but think about this taste.

There are times when I have no choice but to stop by Starbucks, but as always, I felt like I shouldn't expect too much from Starbucks, and I only stop by Starbucks if I spend time at the store.
